TestWorkloadPrioritizationUpgrade::test_.description: 3-node/3-rack cluster with password auth starts on release:2025.1; creates roles role1-3, service levels sl1/sl2 attached to role1/role2, then rolling-upgrades through 2025.3 -> 2025.4 -> 2026.1 -> version under test (upgrade_test.py:31, clone_upgrade_path). If the cluster runs gossip topology and reaches >=2026.1, it migrates to raft topology and waits for service levels v2 (wait_for_sl_v2). After upgrade it waits for the shares column and WORKLOAD_PRIORITIZATION feature, ALTERs sl2 shares, CREATEs sl3 WITH shares and attaches it to role3, waits for 'service level "sl3" was added.' in every node log, then connects per-node exclusive sessions per role and asserts via REST /service_levels/count_connections that each role's connections sit in sl:<name>, and via query tracing that reads run in that scheduling group with the matching reader concurrency semaphore. Guards service-level data/scheduling surviving real version upgrades (and the gossip->raft SL v1->v2 migration).
